DivisionNotes: TemporalNesting is set to true because the Spec operator includes WF_vars(Next), which is a weak fairness condition semantically containing nested temporal operators (a diamond inside a box).

Operators like DownSource and Next were placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef because they represent transition logic (actions) containing primed variables, which prevents them from being classified as state predicates.
The kind operator was placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef because it returns string literals (e.g., "leader", "source") rather than Boolean values.
The expression [valsRcvd -> incoming[n]] was classified as FunctionConstructor_SetType because it defines a set of functions used as a domain for a quantifier.
